title: crataegus americana
intro: Crataegus americana, commonly known as American hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to support cardiovascular health, with its health benefits including reducing blood pressure, improving heart function, and enhancing lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of American hawthorn are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory, helping to protect against cardiovascular disease and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of American hawthorn include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
